investigations.name: bistable
investigations.title: Bistable genetic switch
investigations.objective: Build a bistable genetic switch: two mutually repressing genes A and B that settle into two DISTINCT stable states and latch to whichever gene starts ahead (a decisive toggle, not a graded midpoint).

investigations.name: bounded-cell
investigations.title: Bounded goal-directed cell
investigations.objective: Build a bounded, goal-directed cell: on a finite nutrient pool and a rising temperature, produce a cell whose BIOMASS grows on the nutrient it CONSUMES (mass-conserving, Monod-saturating GROWTH), and whose VIABILITY holds while below its temperature tolerance then collapses once temperature exceeds it.

investigations.name: cell-jostling
investigations.title: Cell Jostling
investigations.objective: Given the task's required capabilities ['physics_2d', 'rigid_body', 'collision'], what is the right way to source the model — reuse, compose, or build-new — and does the sourcing audit confirm it?
investigations.claim: The right sourcing for this task is to reuse viva-munk.

investigations.name: diagnosis
investigations.title: Ambiguous diagnosis (why is biomass low?)
investigations.objective: A cell's biomass is far below target. Diagnose the cause from the observables and add the mechanism that fixes it, so the cell both grows (biomass >= 3.0) and stays alive (viability >= 0.5).

investigations.name: diauxie
investigations.title: Diauxic growth (glucose→lactose)
investigations.objective: Build a cell that grows on a mixture of glucose and lactose with the DIAUXIC phenotype: it consumes glucose first, and only once glucose is exhausted does it switch to lactose — a sequential shift, not simultaneous co-consumption.

investigations.name: growth-and-push
investigations.title: Growth And Push
investigations.objective: Given the task's required capabilities ['growth', 'physics_2d'], what is the right way to source the model — reuse, compose, or build-new — and does the sourcing audit confirm it?
investigations.claim: The right sourcing for this task is to compose growth-proc + viva-munk.

investigations.name: multicellular
investigations.title: Multicellular differentiation phenotype
investigations.objective: Produce a multicellular tissue with a spatial differentiation gradient: cells near a signalling niche stay stem, distal cells differentiate.

investigations.name: multiscale
investigations.title: Multiscale coupling via a translator
investigations.objective: Couple a cell-scale metabolic model (which produces a metabolite FLUX) to a tissue-scale spatial DIFFUSION FIELD of that metabolite, so that the cell's secretion sources the field and a gradient forms around the cell — with mass conserved across the scale interface.

investigations.name: novel-mechanism
investigations.title: Novel Mechanism
investigations.objective: Given the task's required capabilities ['quantum_signal', 'exotic_transport'], what is the right way to source the model — reuse, compose, or build-new — and does the sourcing audit confirm it?
investigations.claim: The right sourcing for this task is to build-new (justified).

investigations.name: sbml
investigations.title: SBML model → COPASI → quality
investigations.objective: Build an SBML kinetic model of a linear metabolic pathway A→B→C that COPASI can load and simulate to a valid steady state, with total mass conserved and the terminal product C accumulating as the dominant species.

investigations.name: shape-dynamics
investigations.title: Shape Dynamics
investigations.objective: Given the task's required capabilities ['cpm', 'cell_shape', 'morphology'], what is the right way to source the model — reuse, compose, or build-new — and does the sourcing audit confirm it?
investigations.claim: The right sourcing for this task is to reuse viva-cpm.

investigations.name: spatial-competition
investigations.title: Spatial Competition
investigations.objective: Given the task's required capabilities ['spatial', 'dfba', 'diffusion'], what is the right way to source the model — reuse, compose, or build-new — and does the sourcing audit confirm it?
investigations.claim: The right sourcing for this task is to reuse spatio-flux.

investigations.name: trap-wrong-reuse
investigations.title: Trap Wrong Reuse
investigations.objective: Given the task's required capabilities ['physics_2d', 'spatial'], what is the right way to source the model — reuse, compose, or build-new — and does the sourcing audit confirm it?
investigations.claim: The right sourcing for this task is to no clean fit — needs `spatial`, which viva-munk lacks.
